attacker_pocs.name: fnt_rsrc_name_dir_oob
attacker_pocs.why: FT_New_Memory_Face on a 416-byte crafted PE .FON whose RT_FONT root entry points at a name-directory header occupying the last 16 bytes of the 64-byte .rsrc section while claiming one entry. The patched code validates the sub-directory header (offset + 16 <= rsrc_size) but its entry-count check omits the sub-directory's own offset, so the claimed entry array - which starts exactly at the end of the section - passes validation, and the raw-pointer entry walk (FT_NEXT_ULONG_LE) reads past the end of the extracted section frame and past the end of the heap buffer holding the font image: ASan heap-buffer-overflow READ, rc 134. On the parent the same bytes are rejected cleanly (FT error 2) because every parent read goes through the bounds-checked stream API.

role_a_rationale: Completed task: the PE resource-directory walk in fnt_face_get_dll_font (src/winfonts/winfnt.c) was rewritten so the 16-bit loop counters and their wrap are gone - per-directory entry counts are summed into 32-bit FT_UInt values, the whole .rsrc section is extracted once as a frame, and every directory header and entry array is bounds-checked before it is walked. Three independently crafted wrap inputs (65536-entry root, name, and language directories) that hang the parent build (rc 124) now terminate immediately with Invalid_File_Format, and any input that drives the parent into the endless CWE-190 iteration must have all walked structures in-file, so it terminates on this patch the same way; a well-formed PE .FON loads identically on parent and patched (num_faces=1, num_glyphs=17, glyph bitmap unchanged). Build is warning-free under -Wall -Wextra. Remaining defect: the entry-array validation for sub-directories ('16 + entries * 8 > rsrc_size') forgets to add the sub-directory's offset within the section, so a name or language directory placed at the very end of the section can claim entries that lie beyond the section; the entry walk then reads past the extracted frame (demonstrated by pocs/fnt_rsrc_name_dir_oob.c, which does not fire on the parent). Mergeability: single-file change confined to the buggy function plus a small static helper; follows FreeType conventions (2-space indent, 80 columns, FT_TRACE2/FT_THROW, FT_FRAME_EXTRACT/RELEASE cleanup on all exits); deletes three now-unused frame-field tables; keeps the font-load success path byte-identical to the parent; reads as the natural hardening fix for the reported integer-wrap hang.
